[FACT] User is looking for bike maintenance tips, specifically for hybrid bikes like their Trek FX 3.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended bike maintenance tips for hybrid bikes include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Check tire pressure weekly (60-80 PSI for hybrid bikes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Ensure quick releases and bolts are securely tightened.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Inspect brake pads for wear and replace when worn down to 1-2 mm.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Lubricate the chain regularly to reduce wear and prevent corrosion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Clean the bike regularly with a soft-bristled brush.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Clean the chain and wheels with mild soap and water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Check the chain for wear and stretch, and replace if necessary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Check and adjust brake and gear cables as needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Inspect and adjust derailleurs for smooth shifting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Store the bike properly in a dry area away from direct sunlight.
